mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates for equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 4.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 4.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous expansion in industrial production and housing starts indicates robust economic activity, boosting corporate profits and investor confidence, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when both INDPRO and HOUST exceed their respective thresholds, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals aggressive monetary tightening, increasing borrowing costs and reducing corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained growth in non-farm payrolls above 100,000 jobs per month signals a strengthening labor market, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS growth exceeds 100,000, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts below 1100 thousand units signals weak consumer demand for housing, indicating broader economic slowdown and reducing corporate revenue expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST falls below 1100, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising federal funds rate combined with a falling unemployment rate indicates tightening monetary policy during a strong labor market, often preceding economic slowdown and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: tightening cycle with strong labor market
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.0% and UNRATE is below 4.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 100 (2017 base) signals supply-side contraction, reducing corporate output and profitability, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO falls below 100, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.
